bibliographic.title: Roma Tenebris
bibliographic.author: voidrim
bibliographic.description:
Roman Republic senator's schemes simulator

Immerse yourself in the life of an ancient politician. Join the mighty Roman Republic Senate. Negotiate, lie, bribe, compromise, force, manipulate - do anything to strengthen your positions. And do not forget to bring glory to Rome.

Each game unique opponents are generated
Five ways to influence them
Ending depends on both plot decisions and in-game results


Roma Tenebris is a text-based simulation game with elements of startegy created in October 2023 for Bare-Bones Jam. It was an interesting, although a bit fatiguing, experience to try using Twine not only as a software for plot organisation but as a medium for coding. Finally, this is more of a sketch rather than a complete game, and still it represents some of the ideas and mechanics which could be implemented into a larger project.
